svg.text: The Phase 1 slice of the blueprint
Two nodes implemented, one placeholder, one untouched. All four share the single subnet 10.99.0.0/24.
one ethernet pin per node, star topology, single flat subnet
the bench generates and transmits messages; the V2X ECU receives,
decodes and forwards them. The ADA node runs the Phase 0 connectivity
tool as a listener so that arrival can be observed; its production code
is Phase 2. The IVI node keeps the supplied artifact and receives nothing.
